overview.description: The Tema Listed Private Managers ETF (PRVT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund is actively managed, with substantial investments in US companies classified under GICS as Asset Management and Custody Banks. PRVT was launched on Oct 1, 2025 and is issued by Tema.
